originalQuestion.stem: 在放疗靶区概念中，PTV最直接用于处理什么问题？
options: 围绕CTV考虑定位、运动与实施等几何不确定性
仅统计肉眼可见肿瘤，不考虑实施误差
自动表示肿瘤已经向周围扩散
originalQuestion.explanation: A：PTV是几何计划体积，旨在处理CTV在治疗实施中的位置与形状等不确定性；B对应GTV的一部分含义，C把计划体积误认作疾病进展。

rows.directSubclaim: PTV accounts for internal/set-up/intra-treatment geometric variation
rows.remaining: Actual margins depend on institutional technique and measured uncertainties; illustrative1cm in old source not a universal recommendation
rows.status: conditional subclaim support, not expert approval
rows.revisionSuggestion: Retain bounded current wording; do not add universal tolerances/margins or guaranteed outcomes

originalQuestion.stem: 下列关于体外放射治疗分次安排及其物理、生物学意义的说法，哪项更准确？
options: 只要总Gy相等，任何分次方式的生物效应都一样
分次数和每次剂量可以不经专业团队随意设置
分次、总量、治疗时间和组织反应共同影响临床计划
originalQuestion.explanation: C保留分次的医学和生物学背景。A、B不当简化真实放疗，算术示例不代表临床处方。

rows.directSubclaim: Total dose alone does not describe clinical course; schedules have biological/healthy-tissue considerations
rows.remaining: No quantitative biological equivalence formula or disease-specific protocol established here
rows.status: conditional subclaim support, not expert approval
rows.revisionSuggestion: Retain bounded current wording; do not add universal tolerances/margins or guaranteed outcomes

originalQuestion.stem: 累计DVH中的V5Gy[%]最直接表示什么？
options: 该结构所有体素恰好受到5 Gy
结构中受到至少5 Gy的体积百分比
患者实际肿瘤治愈概率为5%
originalQuestion.explanation: B：V5Gy[%]是结构累计体积分布指标；并非每点恰好等于5 Gy，也不能从DVH指标直接推断治愈率。

rows.directSubclaim: Cumulative DVH gives volume receiving at least a specified dose, including percentage representation
rows.remaining: No spatial location, individual outcomes or cure probability derivable fromV5Gy alone
rows.status: conditional subclaim support, not expert approval
rows.revisionSuggestion: Retain bounded current wording; do not add universal tolerances/margins or guaranteed outcomes

originalQuestion.stem: 关于GTV、CTV与OAR，下列哪项符合基本定义？
options: OAR是应该忽略的正常结构，计划无须关注
GTV描述明显病灶，CTV可包含潜在亚临床相关组织，OAR须评估受照
CTV只包含空气，不与肿瘤有关
originalQuestion.explanation: B较完整地对应基本概念。GTV/CTV由临床专业人员勾画，OAR的评价也是计划的重要部分。

rows.directSubclaim: GTV visible/palpable disease;CTV may contain subclinical disease;OAR affects plan evaluation
rows.remaining: Clinical delineation and specific dose constraints require qualified multidisciplinary review
rows.status: conditional subclaim support, not expert approval
rows.revisionSuggestion: Retain bounded current wording; do not add universal tolerances/margins or guaranteed outcomes

originalQuestion.stem: 隔日：图像引导和计划验证对放疗有什么作用？
options: 不必进行，因为计划一旦保存绝不可能有实施误差
只要有CT图像就可以跳过专业审签
帮助核实靶区位置与实施条件，但仍需团队QA和专门验证
originalQuestion.explanation: C：影像引导和验证可帮助处理定位及实施差异，但不是无条件的治疗安全保证。

rows.directSubclaim: Image localization and repositioning are important and are subject to separate system commissioning andQA
rows.remaining: No conclusion that imaging eliminates error or replaces professional approval; full workflow/record checks beyond this partial scope
rows.status: conditional subclaim support, not expert approval
rows.revisionSuggestion: Retain bounded current wording; do not add universal tolerances/margins or guaranteed outcomes
